canonical.meaning: An immutable population snapshot: canonical, key-ordered rows whose content identity is the domain-separated population SHA-256. Amendments are new snapshots linked to the original. A population that fits one storage chunk keeps its rows inline. A larger population keeps no rows here: StoredChunkCount chunk events hold them, and StorageManifestSha256 binds those chunks in order.
